sections.description:
Savings

THE DIPLOMATIC AND CONSULAR OFFICERS (OATHS AND FEES) (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1960
THE DIPLOMATIC AND
CONSULAR OFFICERS (OATHS AND FEES) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1960
ORDINANCE No. XII of 1960
[13th April, 1960]
An Ordinance further to amend the Diplomatic and Consular
Officers (Oaths and Fees) Act, 1948
4. Savings.---Notwithstanding
anything in any law for the time being in force, any oath or affirmation
administered, affidavit taken, or such notarial act done as is referred to in
sub-section (1) of section 3 of the said Act, before the promulgation of this
Ordinance, by a diplomatic or consular officer of Pakistan or of a foreign
country in purported exercise of the powers confer red on him by the said Act
shall be deemed to have been ad ministered, taken or done under the said Act as
amended by this Ordinance, and shall have and shall be deemed always to have
had effect accordingly.
